user.title: Connect to SolarPredict
user.description: Point Home Assistant at your SolarPredict server (self-hosted or Vercel).

data_description.planes: One entry per panel string, e.g. 30:113c:2.5,30:SE:2.0. Tilt: 0 = flat, 90 = vertical. Azimuth: 0 = South, -90 = East, 90 = West — or compass degrees (what your phone's compass app shows) with a 'c' suffix like 113c, or a direction like S, SE, WSW. Capacity in kWp (4000 Wp = 4.0).
data_description.api_token: Only needed if the server has SP_API_TOKEN set (recommended for public/Vercel deployments).

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure SolarPredict
reconfigure.description: Change the server URL, location or panel planes.

data_description.planes: One entry per panel string, e.g. 30:113c:2.5,30:SE:2.0. Tilt: 0 = flat, 90 = vertical. Azimuth: 0 = South, -90 = East, 90 = West — or compass degrees (what your phone's compass app shows) with a 'c' suffix like 113c, or a direction like S, SE, WSW. Capacity in kWp (4000 Wp = 4.0).
data_description.api_token: Only needed if the server has SP_API_TOKEN set (recommended for public/Vercel deployments).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the SolarPredict server. Check the URL.

abort.already_configured: This SolarPredict server is already configured.

data.inverter_kw: Inverter limit in kW (0 = no limit)

data_description.horizon: Elevation in degrees of obstructions around you, comma-separated, evenly spaced starting North (e.g. 8 values = 45° steps). Leave empty for an open horizon.
data_description.damping_morning: Attenuates low-sun production in the morning (shading, dew). 0 = off.
data_description.damping_evening: Attenuates low-sun production in the evening. 0 = off.
data_description.efficiency: Overall system losses (inverter, wiring, soiling). 0.90 is a reasonable default.
